Subject: Quick recap + asks — next steps on approver & procurement

Jamie — thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and clear asks so nothing falls through the cracks: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + routing for customer support (priority queues, SLA enforcement).
- Target launch: pilot with a single product line in Q2 to validate latency and cost improvements.
- Key technical constraint: must satisfy internal security checklist (SOC 2 + data retention policy).

Open items / asks for you
1) Confirm the economic approver (who signs the PO / approves budget) so we can route pricing and contract terms. You mentioned Product leadership might own this — is Alex Carter the approver?
2) Procurement & legal contact for vendor onboarding and standard T&C redlines — please share name + email.
3) Any pre-existing procurement templates/certifications (e.g., vendor form, PII handling) we should prepare for.

Proposed immediate next steps (my suggested timeline)
- Today: you confirm approver and procurement contact (so we don't ping the wrong people).
- By Tue 3/13: I’ll send a one-page Mutual Action Plan + pilot SOW and a cost estimate for the pilot (attached: MVP-cost-estimate.xlsx).
- Week of 3/20: Security/Legal review kickoff (if procurement needs an intro, I’ll loop in our Security & Legal partner).

Attachments: MVP-cost-estimate.xlsx (cost breakout by tokens / instance).

If you prefer, we can do a 15-min sync with Alex + procurement to fast-track approvals. What works best for you?

Best,
Naomi
